Okay, so here's the thing about cooking pasta: most people are doing it wrong. I know, I know, that sounds super judgy, but hear me out! You're probably not using enough water. And you're definitely not salting it enough. My nonna always said the water should taste like the sea, and honestly, she wasn't exaggerating. Also, can we talk about the whole "throw it at the wall" thing? Don't do that. Just... don't. It's weird and it doesn't work and now you've got spaghetti on your wall. The real trick is to taste it! Like, actually put a piece in your mouth about two minutes before the box says it's done. You want it just a tiny bit firm in the center. And for the love of everything, save some pasta water before you drain it. That starchy liquid is basically magic for your sauce. Trust me on this one. Your dinner guests will think you went to culinary school or something!
